#modiinusa #modiinNewyork #newyork #unitedstates #PMModiUSVisit #pmmodiinusa #elonmusk #tesla #twitter 

PM Modi met Mr. Elon Musk, tech pioneer, business magnate and CEO of Tesla Inc. & SpaceX; owner, CTO and chairman of Twitter; founder of the Boring company and X-corp; co-founder of Neuralink and OpenAI, in New York, USA. He appreciated Mr. Musk’s efforts at making technology accessible and affordable in various sectors. Prime Minister invited Mr. Musk to explore opportunities in India for investments in electric mobility and rapidly expanding commercial space sector.
